name: Rayhaan Obsidian, Khadlaj Shiyaaka Shadow & Lattafa His Confession Bundle (3 × 100 ml)
english_product_name: Rayhaan Obsidian, Khadlaj Shiyaaka Shadow & Lattafa His Confession Bundle (3 × 100 ml)
description: This bundle brings together three versatile and modern men’s fragrances that balance freshness, woodiness, and smooth masculinity. It’s designed for someone who wants a complete rotation of clean, woody, and slightly sweet everyday scents. Rayhaan Obsidian opens with a fresh and slightly fruity brightness, blended with smooth woods and subtle sweetness, giving it a clean yet modern designer-style feel. Khadlaj Shiyaaka Shadow delivers a fresh citrus and musky woody profile, making it perfect for daytime wear with its airy, clean, and slightly sharp masculine character. Lattafa His Confession adds a warm, slightly sweet and spicy depth, introducing amber, soft woods, and a smooth sensual finish that elevates the bundle into evening wear. Together, this trio gives you a full scent wardrobe — from fresh daytime confidence to warm evening presence.
